privacy.title: Privacy and personal data
privacy.intro: Ma boussole bien-être was designed to know nothing about you. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), this page explains what happens — and above all what does not happen — when you use the site.

sections.title: In short
list: No cookies, no visitor statistics, no advertising.
Your answers to questionnaires and exercises stay on your device: they are neither transmitted nor saved.
The site loads no external resources (fonts, scripts, icons): everything is served by the site itself.

sections.title: Who is responsible for the site?
paragraphs: The site is published on a personal, non-professional basis by Roddy Ricart, on a not-for-profit basis. The publisher does not collect or keep any personal data about visitors.
Contact: through the discussions of the project's GitHub repository (see the Help and contact page).

sections.title: Your answers to questionnaires and exercises
paragraphs: Answers to self-assessment questionnaires, thoughts written in exercises and completed worksheets are processed only in your browser, in memory. They never leave your device and disappear when you close or reload the page.

PDF documents you choose to download are created on your device, without going through the internet. Once downloaded, they are your sole responsibility: on a shared device, remember to delete them and close the browser tab.

sections.title: What is kept on your device
paragraphs: The site sets no cookies. It only uses your browser's storage for a few settings and to work offline. This information stays on your device and is never sent:
list: your 'Later' choice when the site offers to be installed (kept for 30 days);
the sound setting of the fidget spinner;
your display preference (light or dark), if any;
a copy of the site's pages, so it works without a connection.
after: These items are only used for the site to work and to personalise the interface: under CNIL (French data protection authority) rules, they do not require your consent. You can delete them at any time from your browser settings ('Clear site data').

sections.title: Site hosting
paragraphs: The site is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc. and GitHub B.V.). Like any host, GitHub logs visitors' IP addresses for security purposes. These logs are managed by GitHub, under its responsibility; the site's publisher has no access to them.

Data may be processed in the United States. GitHub states that it safeguards these transfers with the European Commission's standard contractual clauses and that it participates in the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. GitHub's Data Protection Officer: dpo{'@'}github.com.

sections.title: Links to other sites
paragraphs: The site links to external sites (3114, ameli.fr, Psycom, scientific articles…). Once on those sites, their own privacy rules apply.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: The GDPR gives you rights over your data: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability. As the publisher holds no data about you, there is no information to provide or erase. For connection logs kept by the host, contact GitHub.
If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr) or your local data protection authority.

sections.title: Purpose of the site
paragraphs: Ma boussole bien-être offers free calming exercises, information about anxiety and self-assessment questionnaires. The site can be used without registration and without advertising.

sections.title: Medical disclaimer
paragraphs: The site's content is for information and well-being. It does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. The site is not a medical device.
Questionnaire results are not a diagnosis: only a healthcare professional can interpret them in your situation.
The site is not an emergency service. In distress or danger in France: 3114 (national suicide prevention line, 24/7), 15 (emergency medical service) or 112.

sections.title: Self-assessment questionnaires
paragraphs: The questionnaires (PHQ-9, GAD-7, WHO-5, AUDIT, Rosenberg scale) are reproduced in their validated French versions, in accordance with their authors' terms of use, shown on each questionnaire. They remain the property of their authors.

sections.title: Intellectual property and licence
paragraphs: The site's code is free software, distributed under the GNU GPL version 3: you may use, study, modify and redistribute it, provided you keep the same licence.
The site is derived from the free project Anxiety Aid Tools (Alvin Unreal and contributors), from which it reuses illustrations and audio narrations, distributed under the same licence.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: The site is provided free of charge, 'as is', with no guarantee of availability or freedom from errors. The publisher strives to check published information and its sources, but cannot guarantee it suits every situation. The exercises are general well-being tools: stop an exercise if it makes you uncomfortable, and talk to a healthcare professional.

support.title: Help and contact
support.intro: A question about the site, an error to report, an idea for improvement? Here is how to get help.

sections.title: About the site
paragraphs: Ma boussole bien-être is a free, open-source site, with no account, no advertising and no tracking. It offers exercises to live with anxiety, explanations and self-assessment questionnaires validated in French. It works in a browser and can be installed on a smartphone's home screen.

sections.title: What you'll find on the site
list: Calming visualizations narrated in French and English
Thought labeling, leaves on a stream and the 'Questioning a thought' worksheet
Worry time and the self-compassion break
Sensory tools (bubbles, stress ball, fidget spinner) and sound therapy
Self-assessment questionnaires (in French), with PDF export
A page to understand anxiety and a page to get help in France

sections.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Contact is through the project's GitHub repository. A (free) GitHub account is needed to post; messages are public: do not include any personal or health information.
This contact does not provide medical follow-up or quick replies. If you are struggling, call 3114 in France (24/7) or, in immediate danger, 15 or 112.

faq.q: How do I install it on my phone?
faq.a: On a smartphone, a banner offers it; you can also use the ☰ menu, then 'Install the app'.

faq.q: Which exercise should I start with?
faq.a: When anxiety rises, try 2-minute breathing or 5-4-3-2-1 grounding. To understand what is happening, read the 'Understanding anxiety' page.

faq.q: Can a clinician recommend the site to patients?
faq.a: Yes, the site is free and open source. Questionnaires and exercises do not replace a clinical assessment; PDF worksheets can support a discussion during an appointment.

sections.title: Important information
paragraphs: This site provides general information and well-being tools. It does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If anxiety persists or affects your daily life, talk to your doctor or a mental health professional.
